checks: empty workspace and live SSE connection
SSE updates the dashboard after a valid sample
two abnormal samples do not open a persistent alert
third abnormal sample opens one durable alert and chart
identical sample retry leaves counts and alert history unchanged
changed payload with a reused sample ID is rejected
invalid readings and unknown equipment do not persist
normal sample resolves the alert without erasing history
equipment selection isolates readings and equipment state
polling recovers new readings while SSE is unavailable
Prometheus metrics match persisted readings and alert status
scope: Synthetic readings in a disposable database. No physical equipment or sustained-load validation.
